'''Kim Hyun-Min''' ({{Korean|hangul=김현민}}; born March 20, 1966) is a professor in the department of mathematics at [[Pusan National University]]<ref>{{cite web |url= https://math.pusan.ac.kr/matheng/20289/subview.do?enc=Zm5jdDF8QEB8JTJGcG51UHJvZmwlMkZtYXRoZW5nJTJGNTczJTJGNjQ1OCUyRmFydGNsVmlldy5kbyUzRmZpbmRUeXBlJTNEJTI2ZmluZFdvcmQlM0QlMjZwYWdlJTNEMSUyNg%3D%3D |title= Professors |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= |website= [[Pusan National University]] |publisher= |access-date= 16 May 2023 |quote= }}</ref> among other positions at the university.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.daejonilbo.com/news/articleView.html?idxno=1459948 |script-title=ko:국가수리과학연구소장에 김현민 부산대 교수 내정 |author= 임용우 |work=대전일보 |date= 24 February 2021 |access-date= 26 May 2023 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref> He has served as vice president of the Korean Mathematical Society;<ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.kms.or.kr/eng/introduce/officer.html?dyear=2019 |title= KMS Board Members of 2019~2020 |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= |website= Korean Mathematical Society |publisher= |access-date= 26 May 2023 |quote= }}</ref> vice president of the Youngnam Mathematical Society;<ref name=":0">{{cite web |url= https://www.nims.re.kr/intro/introduce/pageView/621 |script-title=ko:기관장 소개 |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= |website= [[National Institute for Mathematical Sciences]] |publisher= |access-date= 26 May 2023 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.kmooc.kr/courses/course-v1:HonamUniv+HCTL05+2022_AI1/about |script-title=ko:인공지능과 미래기술 (AI+Future Technology) |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= |website= kmooc |publisher= [[National Institute for Lifelong Education]] |access-date= 6 November 2023 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref> director of the Big Data-based Finance, Fisheries, and Manufacturing Innovation Industrial Mathematics Center;<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.etnews.com/20210224000092 |script-title=ko:수리연 신임 소장에 김현민 부산대 교수 내정 |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= 24 February 2021|website= |publisher= |access-date= 26 May 2023 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref> and the sixth president of the [[National Institute for Mathematical Sciences]].<ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.nims.re.kr/intro/pageView/41 |script-title=ko:연혁 |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= |website= [[National Institute for Mathematical Sciences]] |publisher= |access-date= 17 May 2023 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref><ref name=":0" />

==Education==
Kim majored in mathematics in the College of Natural Sciences at Pusan National University for his bachelor's and master's. He earned a second master's degree and a doctorate in mathematics specializing in numerical analysis and calculation at the [[Victoria University of Manchester]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.maths.manchester.ac.uk/~higham/misc/past-students.php  |title= Past PhD Students |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= |website= [[Victoria University of Manchester]] |publisher= |access-date= 16 May 2023 |quote= }}</ref>

==Career==
His first position was as a post-doc in the department of mathematics at [[KAIST]]. Following that, he taught at Pusan National University and held positions at [[Kyungpook National University]], Samsung Heavy Industries College of Engineering, and the Korean Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics.<ref>{{cite web |url= https://ksiam.org/intro/sub_intro02.asp |script-title=ko:이사회: 2011-2012 |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= |website= 한국산업응용수학회 |publisher= |access-date= 24 July 2023 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref>

==Research==
Kim's research is focused on  developing algorithms for solving  various types of nonlinear matrix equations.<ref>{{cite journal |author1= Kim Hyun-Min |author2= Jie Meng |date=2021 |title=Structured perturbation analysis for an infinite size quasi-Toeplitz matrix equation with applications |url= |journal=BIT Numerical Mathematics |volume= 61|issue= 3|pages=859–879 |doi= 10.1007/s10543-021-00847-2|s2cid= 237656432 }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |author1=Lee Hosoo |author2= Kim Hyun-Min |author3= Jie Meng |date= 2020 |title=On the nonlinear matrix equation Xp= A+ MT (X# B) M |url= |journal= Journal of Computational and Applied Mathematics|volume= 373 |issue= |article-number=112380 |doi= 10.1016/j.cam.2019.112380|s2cid= 202130027 }}</ref><ref>{{cite book |author1= Jang Geun Soo |chapter= Development of Algorithm Improving Label Arrangements in Offset Printing |date= 2019 |title=Proceedings of the Forum "Math-for-Industry" 2019 |series= Mathematics for Industry|volume=36 |publisher=Springer |pages= 143–157 |doi=10.1007/978-981-19-1154-5_9 |isbn= 978-981-19-1153-8}}</ref>
